dataset.sampling: Bernoulli selection before reading labels; generator seed 42
dataset.dataset_time_assumption: Source timestamps treated as UTC for benchmark ordering

split_policy: warmup before Sep 4; train Sep 4-7; validation Sep 8; test Sep 9 onward
graph_policy: Frozen past-only directed graph per partition; target-period edges excluded; node IDs are indices only

validation.curve_policy: PR retains every recall change and plateau endpoint; render as steps. ROC retains every true-positive-rate change and plateau endpoint. No uniform subsampling; both plotted areas reproduce their headline metrics.

logistic_regression.method: Jointly shuffle each feature group across validation rows; hold all other features fixed.
logistic_regression.interpretation: AP drop measures model reliance under this perturbation, not causality. Correlated groups can share signal; 32 validation positives make estimates unstable.

limitations: 5% label-blind transaction sample removes graph neighbors and motifs
Synthetic single-source benchmark; one seed and one temporal holdout
No calibration fit; model scores support ranking experiments
Sparse late-period activity can create temporal distribution shift
Explicit source timezones and delayed-arrival fields are unavailable
External bank performance and analyst effort remain unmeasured
